description: This file is a shell script for testing a 'proc-receive' hook in a Git repository. It sets up repositories, configures hooks, and runs tests for different protocols (local and HTTP). The script includes functions to initialize repositories, configure hooks, and execute test cases specific to the hooks' behavior.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Initializes upstream and workbench Git repositories, creates commits, tags, and sets up hooks.

methods.name: run_proc_receive_hook_test
methods.description: Executes test cases for the 'proc-receive' hook using specified protocol (local or HTTP).
